Common Concerns ▼ Fine Lines & Wrinkles Loss of Facial Volume Uneven Skin Tone & Texture Sun Damage & Pigmentation Skin Laxity & Sagging Lips (Volume, Definition & Lines) Acne & Acne Scarring Redness & Rosacea Large Pores & Oily Skin Scars (Surgical, Acne, or Trauma) Neck & Jawline Definition Overall Skin Health & Radiance Body Contouring & Surgical Enhancements Meet the Surgeon Alexander Slocum, MD Alexander Slocum, Jr., MD/PhD, FACS, is a board-certified plastic and reconstructive surgeon with a passion for craftsmanship. A New Hampshire native, Dr. Slocum earned his bachelor’s, master’s, and doctoral degrees in mechanical engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). His background as a master woodworker informs his surgical precision, allowing him to approach each procedure with the artistry and meticulous care of a craftsman, ensuring beautiful and enduring results.
